title: Freedom Yield Metal — Cycle History Audit Packet v1 (per-line)
description: Formal contract for EACH LINE of /api/cycle-history.jsonl. The file is JSONL (line-delimited JSON): each line is one JSON object conforming to this schema. The runtime file is generated by scripts/gen-cycle-history.sh joining /api/uptime-cycles.json with /api/incidents.json. Companion docs: docs/CYCLE_HISTORY.md. Extended 2026-06-21 with additive cross-reference fields (signed_by_key_seq, signed_by_pubkey_fingerprint) that bind each cycle leaf to the operator-identity key authoritative at the cycle's start; see docs/MERKLE_DAG_SPEC.md §2.2. This schema is the authoritative shape v1; breaking changes require a new major version at /api/cycle-history.schema.v2.json. The v1 URL stays reachable for at least 18 months after v2 publication.
x-line-format: Each line of cycle-history.jsonl validates against this schema independently. Use jq, ndjson tooling, or stream the file line-by-line.
$comment: 2026-08-05: cycle-3 close the real data showed final_total_delegated_metal and notes had been declared too narrowly. final_total_delegated_metal was declared type integer, but delegated stake is a fractional METAL quantity in production (cycle-3 real value: 8608.9458) — corrected to type number. notes was declared type string (non-nullable), but the runtime generator (scripts/gen-cycle-history.sh) emits JSON null when no free-text note applies to a cycle (cycle-2 and cycle-3 real values: null) — corrected to type [string, null]. Both were additive-only widenings under the v1 stability contract; no previously-valid document is invalidated. 2026-08-05 (review round 1): final_self_stake_metal was declared type integer for the same reason final_total_delegated_metal was too narrow — scripts/gen-cycle-history.sh passes both fields through uncoerced from uptime-cycles.json, so a future cycle whose self-stake is fractional would fail this schema the same way cycle-3's delegated total did. Widened final_self_stake_metal to type number pre-emptively, before any real violation was observed, to close the same class of bug at the same time.

signed_by_key_seq.description: ADDITIVE (Phase α, 2026-06-21). The key_seq value from /api/identity-history.jsonl that was authoritative on this cycle's start_iso. Operators SHOULD include this field for cycle_n >= 3 (= first cycle after Phase α activation). Earlier closed cycles MAY be reissued with this field populated by reference to the historical key, OR MAY be left without it — the additive-only stability of v1 means absence is not invalid.

signed_by_pubkey_fingerprint.description: ADDITIVE (Phase α, 2026-06-21). The operator_identity_pubkey_fingerprint of the key referenced by signed_by_key_seq. Same hash format as identity.json.operator_identity_pubkey_fingerprint and identity-history.jsonl.operator_identity_pubkey_fingerprint. Lets a verifier perform cross-reference integrity check without consulting identity-history.jsonl (= self-contained binding inside the leaf).
